c4_disclosure.statement: Exploratory values of the primary estimand's analogue (median R(UE), 6x6 grids, rho = 2) were seen before the freeze, on exploratory seeds 9000-9019 only (D-009). No confirmatory seed (1000-1099, 2000-2099) has been solved. On Sioux Falls only UE was solved (J-0012, engine check); no SO and no R was computed on the real network. The amendments did not change delta, the primary cell, the hypotheses or the decision rule; n = 100 was chosen on precision grounds (A2).
